subject: Request: one-time PLG activation token for Accelerator pilot
messages:
From: Elaine Tan <elaine.tan@lumenai.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 08:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Quick ask — small one-off credits for Accelerator pilot extension

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team here at LumenAI is excited to move forward with the Accelerator pilot. We started an initial eval with the self-serve credits and have run into higher token consumption than we projected due to long-context testing.

Would Redwood be able to issue a one-time promo code (single-use) that adds 5k free tokens to the existing PLG trial for the LumenAI pilot? We expect this will let the engineering team finish the integration and give us a final go/no-go this month.

A few constraints on our side: the token top-up must be usable by the account that signed up via PLG (looks like lumenai+pilot@redwood-signup.com) and we prefer a 7-day activation window. No long-term billing changes required.

I attached a short pilot scope and the test plan. If you need an approval email from my manager I can loop them, but wanted to try the quick route first.

Thanks,

Elaine Tan
Head of Integrations, LumenAI
elaine.tan@lumenai.com
(415) 555-0198

Attachment(s): pilot_scope-summary.pdf

Marissa / Rishi — can you confirm we’re OK to do a single-use, 5,000-token manual promo code that targets lumenai+pilot@redwood-signup.com for a 7-day activation window? No discount, just credits on the PLG account. If there are any procurement flags (SLA/enterprise billing) let me know, but per Elaine this is still in the self-serve pilot bracket.

If approved I will generate the code and send redemption instructions to Elaine.

Neha Kapoor
